gameSummary:
JackID (folder jackpit/) — first-person PSX horror casino roguelike + tycoon, Three.js/TS/Vite, solo or 2–8 friends over P2P listen servers. The integration pass is done. docs/PLAN.md is written (1,021 lines). Key decisions:
1. Docs reconciled in place: TECH_SPEC v1.1 gains §11 (binding interface amendments), ART_BIBLE §0.1 reconciliation, GDD v1.1 and both catalogues v1.1. 31 inconsistencies were fixed (ids, zones, slot sizes, hooks, protocol, keymap, currency, render, menu, saving, rooms).
2. Final ids are the catalogue ids (39 machines, 10 system devices). Instance id = GDD slot id. GDD §8 is the only level layout.
3. Six slots changed class to fit the real models: hilo M, mines M, dicetower L, bigsix L (wall wheel Ø1.8), tombola L, bingopin L. The coinflip booth shrinks to 0.78 m (stays S).
4. The Devil's Table now has the Addendum-7 SHELLS duel (MACHINES_tables §5A: 3 rounds, items, defib charges, 2–4 PvP, pays 1.9×) as its main mode. Six Chambers stays as a quick variant.
5. New hooks so every GDD charm has a target: table.shoeInfo, wheel.nudge, coinflip.reflip. One hook→ModHook map (TECH §11.3) and one mc.*→protocol map (TECH §11.4) incl. private `mevp`.
6. Code-shape additions: MachineDef.actionCost/suit, buildModel(kit, {seed, variant}), addStake, settle meta, run.bet pulls, betLimits, payoutFactor, WinTier 'mega', per-round RNG.
7. Final keymap: seated Q = collect, B = max bet; walk Q = punch card, F = use item, B = Totem, ping = MMB/Z, PTT = Y. Currency is ¢ / j.
8. Look: ART look on the TECH API (400×225 FILL, 6-light pool + flicker profiles, camera far 48). Characters use the mannequin GLB + ART masks. Menu = ART geometry + GDD entries; every jackpot lands SUN.
9. Milestones: M0 core (one Opus author) → M1 vertical slice (menu burst, full pit, Big One, terminal, hotline, Pawn Window, Nights 1–3) → M2 all 39 machines + full SP → M3 MP + server browser + Lift lobby → M4 polish. Each has a numeric exit gate.
10. Packages: 31 non-machine packages + mdl-<id> (Opus model.ts) / mc-<id> (Sonnet rest of folder) for 39 machines, in 6 modeler + 8 coder lanes and 4 waves. Exclusive file ownership, with a stub-transfer rule for M0.
11. Addenda 5–8 pool tiered, nothing dropped: SHELLS T1. Parlor Pack (Son Kart, Okey, Pişti, Tavla, Liar's Dice), Originals, boss Nights, Totems, porcelain Collateral, proximity voice T2. Cheating, bar, fusion, Vault, B13, host migration T3.

machines.logicBrief: MACHINES_machines §5, TableBase with 8 seats + 0–4 cosmetic bot "debtors" (no wallet; seated humans + bots ≤ 6). Phases: BOARDING 8.0 s (stake 1–500 via betLimits; optional auto target presets 1.5/2/3/5/10/20/50/100/250, Shift+wheel ±0.05; Space confirms) → DOORS 1.5 s (bets locked, debited, fair hash broadcast) → RIDE m(t) = e^(0.07t) → SNAP or ROOF (×250) 2.0 s → AFTERMATH 4.0 s. Crash point at DOORS: U 52-bit uniform, crash = min(250, max(1, floor(100·0.96/U)/100)); RTP 96 % for every target. Cash-out: client sends act {out, r, tc}; host accepts at m(max(tRecv − min(rtt/2, 150 ms + lateStep), tLastAccepted)) if < tSnap, else fell. Payout scaling uses run.payoutFactor applied to profit and stake (meta.factorApplied). actionCost 1 per ride joined; watchers free. Luck "Safety Net": on a fall refund 50 % with p = min(0.30, 0.01·L) (tag refund). Falls are tagged loss + bust (Sapper's Badge). Controls: Space or LMB on own lever = step off; wheel/Z/X stake and 1–9 targets during BOARDING; H rules; E leaves only during boarding. Events: phase {phase, endsAt}, seat {p, seat, stake, auto, bot?}, lock {fair}, go {t0} (clients compute m locally), out {p, mult, payout, auto}, snap {crash, tSnap, seed} / roof. Hooks m.elevator.autoInsurance, lateStep, floorBonus, onFall, onRoof. Milestones L10 floorBonus +0.02, L25 lateStep, L50 autoInsurance, L100 luck +5. Disconnect: auto target honoured, otherwise rides to the snap. Juice §5.9 (creak, floor dings, SNAP twang + shriek + wind + impact, car flicker grows with m). Achievement top_floor ×100+.

LOCK 0.6 (bets debited, fair hash), LIFT 1.0 (N revealed), COUNT: the wand removes groups of 4 (every 0.35 s, after 10 groups 0.20 s, the last 12 buttons at 0.60 s per group; 5–9 s) until 1–4 remain = r; REVEAL 1.0 (final buttons glow, gong), PAYOUT ≤ 2.0, SWEEP 1.0. Host draws r uniform 1–4 and k uniform 0–19; N = 40 + 4k + r (sent only at LIFT, after bets lock). RTP 96.25 % (Fan) – 98.75 % (Ssh). actionCost 1 per count; autoplay allowed. Luck: solo reroll (p = L/100) / shared refund. Controls LMB on the square (sides = Fan, corners = Kwok, drag from the win side to the push side = Nim), 1–4 quick Fan, Space Ready, common table keys. Events scoop, lift {n, layoutSeed}, count {stepMs[]}, result {r, seats}, peek {even} (private: N's parity before LOCK). machines.logicBrief: MACHINES_tables §23, TableBase PvP with 6 seats; bots fill empty seats (3 difficulty levels). Table ante A ∈ {5, 20, 100} (× SI scale, L10 adds a 500 table). A pot cycle starts with every seated player anteing A. Turns go clockwise; spin the top (stem flick or Space; 8 s timer → auto-spin): each face 1/8 (weights base 100): +1 put A, +2 put 2A, ALL+ everyone puts A, −1 take A, −2 take 2A, ½ take floor(pot/2), ALL take the whole pot (cycle ends), ∅ nothing. Before spinning you may declare Double (D): ±1 / ±2 amounts doubled for this spin. Takes are capped by the pot; broke players sit out; after 20 spins the pot is split. Rake 5 % of every ALL take and of the final split. RTP ≈ 97.4 % (zero-sum minus rake). Puts are added with addStake; one outcome per player per cycle (bet = ante + puts, payout = takes). actionCost 1 pull per pot cycle. Luck applies only against bots: a losing face (+1, +2, ALL+) on your spin is respun once with p = L/100 when no other human is seated. Controls stem flick / Space, D Double, 1 sit out next cycle, Q leave after this cycle. Phases ANTE 1.5/TURN 8/SPIN 2.5–5.0 (spin, precession, fall)/APPLY 1.0/CYCLE_END 2.0. Events ante {seats, pot}, turn {seat, timeoutMs}, double {seat}, spin {seat, face, durMs, precessSeed}, apply {seat, face, moves, pot}, end {rake, split}. Hooks m.teetotum.faceWeight.face (no other human), takeBonus (House-paid), putShield; x.table.rakeDelta; x.table.peekCharges (the top wobbles toward a take face, 80 %). Milestones L10 ante-500 table, L25 rake 4 %, L50 golden face (pays double), L100 owner earns the rake of all teetotum tables. Juice §23.11. HOUSE feat: a take-all result.

Pieces: the menu theme "Inside the Jackpot" (D minor 84 BPM), 9 zone themes (GDD §6.9 keys/BPM/progressions), the House motif D4–F4–A4–G♯4–A4 re-harmonised in every cue, and 12 jukebox songs (AABA 32 bars, 3 voicings per bar, 15 % ornaments, fills every 8 bars, 2 solo options). Cues: Collection (PAID fermata / SHORT tritone), trapdoor, Topside (first major statement), jackpot fanfare (C → A♭ at bar 5), stingers, cutscene cues. Same seed = same arrangement; different seeds never identical.

systemsPackages.title: System device logic: Pawn Window, Concession Desk, Cashier, Apothecary, Jukebox, Tape deck, Bounty Board, Moth Shrine
systemsPackages.brief: Interaction and presentation for the lobby systems, delegating rules to the game packages. Pawn Window: intermission-only shutter, stock display, buy/sell/reroll/lock/remove-curse via game-charms, 2 players at once, Cashier as second window at N ≥ 4. Concession Desk: Ledger of Leases, Machine Orders, House Improvements, wing purchases, staff roster via game-tycoon (Clerk bell + head turn). Cashier: Free Casino House Credit 500 × SI. Apothecary: E + 1–4, drink via player viewmodel, game-buffs tonics. Jukebox: 1 Ticket, 12 songs, buff via game-buffs, MP latest wins, reversed play in the Witching Watch. Tape deck: play collected tapes with subtitles. Bounty Board: game-circuit contracts. Shrine: candle cost max(5 × SI, 5 % pocket), blessings/curses via game-buffs, once per Watch.
